column1: # Declarative items removed from the IEEE 1076-2019 package sources to give the
# Columns (tab separated): standard, package, item key, clause, reason.
# The key is the normalized declaration: kind|name(parameter types)->result for
# subprograms (a body is removed with its declaration), type|name for a type or
# subtype, alias|name=target, constant|name, use|clause. Packages, parameter
# types and result types are lower case; operators keep their quotes.
# 1987, 1993, 2002 and 2008 are the standards of the shipped trees; the 2000
# text equals the 2002 text for these packages, so there is no 2000 tree, and
# 2019 is the original.  The items were found by comparing the 2019 package
# texts with the texts of the older standards (item names, parameter types and
# result types, with UNRESOLVED_ prefixes and STD_ULOGIC/STD_LOGIC ignored);
# an item whose older form differs only in those respects (for instance
# STD_LOGIC_VECTOR, UNSIGNED and SIGNED, which are types in the older texts) is
# kept in its 2019 form and is not listed here.
